scope: Curated cases from archived FAQ, QUICK_REFERENCE, CONTEXT_REFERENCE, changelog; the full 15k exchanges were NOT exhaustively read.

status_meanings.historical_fixed: Archive says patched by this historical version. Recheck version, source and reproducer; do not assume bug remains.
status_meanings.feature_milestone: A feature became available; never infer exact current signature.
status_meanings.expected_behavior: The archived report identifies intentional behavior, not a bug.
status_meanings.stale_guidance: Old instructions or absolute claims conflict with or predate current official docs.
status_meanings.historical_workaround: Context-dependent operational workaround, not a fix.
status_meanings.current_pattern: Architecture principle to verify in current context.

issues.title: ObserversRpc exécuté deux fois en host
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archived host loopback bug with runLocally; normal server/client dual context can also explain two events.
issues.verify: Log server/client roles and RPC call count; inspect runLocally and current installed method; verify effects once on host and dedicated.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Propriété par défaut absente en host
issues.historical_hypothesis: Historically a host ownership initialization bug; current code may instead use a different owner or restrictive network rules.
issues.verify: Inspect current ownership at spawn and after owner-change; compare pure client and host; log asServer and isOwner.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: GameObject dupliqué côté client
issues.historical_hypothesis: Historical client duplication fix; modern duplicates can be caused by auto-start and a second Instantiate or a buffered RPC.
issues.verify: Count Instantiate calls, network IDs, scene object vs prefab spawn, auto-start flags and roles; inspect spawned event order.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: NetworkTransform tremble sous WebTransport
issues.historical_hypothesis: Old transport-related NetworkTransform fix does not diagnose contemporary interpolation without packet evidence.
issues.verify: Compare WebTransport and UDP with same build; log RTT/jitter, authority, update phase, buffers and version.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: NetworkReflection incorrect en host
issues.historical_hypothesis: Host reflection component historical bug; modern issue may be authority and property selection.
issues.verify: Inspect selected properties, writer, ownerAuth, and callback invocation for both host contexts.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Null exception dans SyncVar de référence
issues.historical_hypothesis: Old non-value-type SyncVar exception fix; current null requires reproducer and serialization ownership check.
issues.verify: Capture full stack trace, exact T type, initialization timing and OnSpawn; check module replacement and local version.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Taille de tableau BitPacker incorrecte
issues.historical_hypothesis: Historical array-size packing fix; current failure could be mismatched serializer and read/write field ordering.
issues.verify: Inspect packed type, serialized length, write/read symmetry, ILPP and platform; reproduce in isolated pack/unpack test.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: SyncDictionary ne se sérialise pas
issues.historical_hypothesis: Historical dictionary improvements; current issues often stem from unsupported item serialization or authority.
issues.verify: Check K/V serializer, module declared as field, initialization before spawn, writer permission, and late join behavior.

issues.title: PlayerSpawner apparaît dans mauvaise scène

issues.verify: Compare spawner scene, new instance scene and each client loaded scene; verify scene prefab scope and network rules.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Exclusion de paramètres NetworkAnimator
issues.historical_hypothesis: Historical feature for excluding selected animation hashes; mechanism can differ in newer versions.
issues.verify: Inspect installed NetworkAnimator Inspector, sync selection, triggers and bandwidth profiler before adding custom messages.

issues.title: isOwner faux pendant OnDespawn
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archived note explicitly calls this expected behaviour, not a bug. Teardown may occur after ownership is cleared.
issues.verify: Capture old owner before despawn if needed; base cleanup on server context, stored identifiers and lifecycle, not only isOwner.
issues.note: The archive labels this expected behavior around v1.3.3; do not recommend upgrading to fix an expected lifecycle state.

issues.verify: Check authoritative list contents before join, ownerOnly, observer registration, scene load, snapshot and both client logs.

issues.verify: Distinguish RPC invocation count from method body execution, runLocally and host side; confirm installed build version.

issues.verify: Check spawn batch/observer readiness, bufferLast target, sender, channel and late-join durable state alternative.

issues.title: Generic RPC échec ILPP ou IL2CPP

issues.verify: Capture full ILPP diagnostic, Unity version, generic closed instantiations, .asmdef, IL2CPP/Mono and package SHA; isolate minimal case.

issues.verify: Check transport channel, target observer, object spawned at send, per-target buffering, Unity runtime log and release source.

issues.title: Rigidbody et Transform jitter lors du parenting/teleport

issues.verify: Check authority, parent reference, interpolation, teleport API, physics double-writer and 2D/3D; compare clean spawn.

issues.title: SyncVar/collections divergent au reconnect/pooling

issues.verify: Check OnPoolReset, initial snapshot, serialization type, ownerOnly and ownership transfer; test two lifetimes of same pooled instance.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Paquets Unreliable fragmentés/perdus
issues.historical_hypothesis: 1.20.0 included improvements to fragmentation and MTU handling; delivery can still fail normally for unreliable packets.
issues.verify: Inspect transport MTU, fragmentation policy, channel, Bandwidth Profiler drop reason, payload size, and corruption vs normal loss.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.historical_hypothesis: 1.20.0 changelog includes asset/scene/Addressables fixes; current failures may involve scope and registry.
issues.verify: Check global vs scene registries, PrefabProvider, Addressables loaded, scene identity mapping, client build assets and loading order.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.verify: Record Unity version, target, stripping mode, Scripting Backend, link.xml, asmdef and full build log; compare Editor vs build.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Prediction late join, pool or input replay divergence
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archive PurrDiction 1.2.3/1.3.3 changelogs cover input disposal, hierarchy, replays and late join. Do not compare against core version.
issues.verify: Identify PurrDiction version separately; snapshot state, input, predicted hierarchy, policy, pools, isVerifiedView and tick delta.
issues.note: Version is for PurrDiction, NOT PurrNet core; time window spans multiple releases; 1.3.3 is latest milestone named in this archived summary.

issues.title: SteamWorks CS1061 après import
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archive suggests restarting Unity after adding Steamworks; that may only clear stale compilation/package state.
issues.verify: Inspect real missing member/type, installed Steamworks.NET version, .asmdef and compile errors; restart only after recording logs.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Unity ne trouve pas git
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archive recommends installing Git and restarting Editor/Hub; local environment/configuration issue not necessarily PurrNet.
issues.verify: Run git --version in same shell as Unity, check executable PATH and restart Hub; keep UPM error log.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Ancienne affirmation: pas d’intégration Dissonance
issues.historical_hypothesis: Historical FAQ says integration absent, but current official documentation contains Dissonance integration instructions.
issues.verify: Prefer current docs and repository for integration; verify installed addon, Dissonance and transport.
issues.note: CONTRADICTED by PurrDocs/main and official packages listing; never repeat historical negative claim as a current fact.

issues.title: Ancienne règle absolue sur Transform/GameObject
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archive says Transform/GameObject never serialize, but modern PurrNet supports object/transform packers under specific registration/spawn conditions.
issues.verify: Check actual type and whether its NetworkIdentity is spawned/registered/visible; when in predicted STATE use PredictedObjectID, for deferred classic references evaluate SyncLazyRef.
issues.note: Older blanket claims are overbroad; some non-networked Transform references still serialize as null. Verify exact installed packer and context.

issues.title: Ancien onPlayerJoinedScene utilisé comme signal prêt
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archived FAQ proposes onPlayerJoinedScene for readiness and onPlayerDisconnected; current docs distinguish membership from scene loaded, and show onPlayerLeft.
issues.verify: For ready-to-spawn use onPlayerLoadedScene; for leave use onPlayerLeft; distinguish membership vs completed loading; verify APIs.
issues.note: The older callback names may still exist for other semantics; do not claim they never existed.

issues.title: Ancien latest/stable v1.20.0 et vieux dépôt BlenMiner
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archive index calls v1.20.0 latest, relative to Aug 2026; not valid for contemporary installs.
issues.verify: Inspect lock SHA and installed package.json, compare official PurrNet/PurrNet release package; do not auto-upgrade or invent version.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.

issues.title: Ancien avertissement relay PurrTransport dev-only
issues.historical_hypothesis: Archived support advice described its free relay in 2024/25 as development only; this is deployment and service-policy dependent.
issues.verify: Check official current PurrTransport documentation, relay terms, capacity, deployment architecture and latest package.
issues.note: Never generalize a historical service limitation to every present PurrTransport topology.

issues.title: Chat entre serveurs non connectés
issues.historical_hypothesis: Independent PurrNet servers cannot receive each other’s ordinary object RPCs directly without a messaging bridge.
issues.verify: Design authenticated backend/pubsub, moderation, delivery and persistence separately from per-match networking.
issues.note: Archived incident: the claimed patch/version is historical evidence, not proof of current regression or a mandatory upgrade.
